checkNames.confirmedBy: build_financials.repair_q4_document on a copy leaves each derivation-rejected value null

gloss.Q1–Q3 diluted EPS 缺漏: Q1 to Q3 diluted EPS missing
gloss.年度 EPS 與淨利／股數不一致: annual EPS disagrees with its net income over diluted shares (more than 15%)
gloss.年度或季度來源非 SEC: annual or quarterly source is not SEC
gloss.年度／季度期別缺漏、重複或不唯一: annual or quarterly period missing, duplicated or not unique
gloss.方法 A 推算 EPS 與 Q4 淨利符號不一致: derived Q4 EPS and Q4 net income have different signs
gloss.方法 A 推算值未通過 Q4 淨利／股數檢查: derived Q4 EPS fails the check against Q4 net income over shares
gloss.方法 A 股數基準差超過 25%: annual and quarterly share bases differ by more than 25%
gloss.方法 A 通過檢查但仍未填值（需檢查資料形狀）: no check fails (the derivation accepts the value)
gloss.缺股數且 EPS 無效，無法推算股數: a period has no diluted shares and no usable EPS, so its share basis is unknown
gloss.缺股數且缺淨利，無法推算股數: a period has neither diluted shares nor net income, so its share basis is unknown

checkNames.source: audit_q4_eps_backfill.method_a_rejection, the check names the existing derivation reports

reconciliation.note: Counting only files that carry an epsDiluted list leaves out the Q4 rows of the files without one. Every such row is missing, so this report counts them as null and classifies them.

rowDefinition.classRule: first matching class in classOrder wins
rowDefinition.missing: quarterly.values.epsDiluted[i] is null; a file with no epsDiluted list at all counts every Q4 row as missing (an absent list has no value at i)
rowDefinition.unit: one record per missing US Q4 row, keyed by symbol (file name) and end
rowDefinition.usRow: quarterly.fq[i] == 4 in a file with market == "US"; index.json and other markets are skipped
